programme.title: Košarka: NBA - The Best of / Košarka: NBA - The Best of
programme.desc: The sixth day of June of June 1946. years will change the basketball game forever. On that day in New York, the most elite world basketball competition, the NBA league was founded. 29 Teams from the US and one from Canada Each autumn begins the hunt for the legendary ring intended for the Champions of the NBA league. The teams are divided into an east and western conference and through 82 regular season, the regular season hunting one of the eight playoff positions. Conference champions are entering the large NBA final where in a series of a maximum of seven games decide on the new champion. The NBA final is one of the most accurate sports events of the year that delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna meseca davne 1946. godine zauvek će promeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gde u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. NBA finale je jedno od najpraćenijih sportskih događaja godine koje oduševljava sve košarkaške zaljubljenike.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League: CSKA - Zenit / Košarka - VTB liga: CSKA - Zenit

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: FMP - Cedevita Olympia / Košarka - ABA liga: FMP - Cedevita Olimpija

On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg brata FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. programme.title: Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Galatasaray - Elfsborg / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Galatasaray - Elfsborg
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Music evening: Gala concert at the Garnier Opera in Paris / Glasbeni večer: Gala koncert v Operi Garnier v Parizu
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 150th anniversary of the Garnier Palace, there are numerous cultural events and celebrations. One of them was a concert of the Vienna Philharmonic with renowned opera soloists. Performed by Mexican tenor Rolando Villazon, Peruvian tenor Juan Diego Florez from Peru, Welsh Bas Baritonist Sir Bryn Terfel and Bulgarian soprano Sonya Yoncheva. They presented themselves in the roles from operas Aleko, Faust, Carmen, Le CID, Seekers of Pearls, Traviata and Musical Man from La Manche. 1, P. I. Tchaikovsky. The concert was led by Canadian conductor Yannick Nezet-Seguin. / Ob 150-letnici Palača Garnier se v njej vrstijo številni kulturni dogodki in praznovanja. Eden izmed njih je bil tudi koncert Dunajskih filharmonikov s priznanimi opernimi solisti. Nastopili so mehiški tenorist Rolando Villazon, perujski tenorist Juan Diego Florez iz Peruja, valižanski bas baritonist sir Bryn Terfel in bolgarska sopranistka Sonya Yoncheva. Predstavili so se v vlogah iz oper Aleko, Faust, Carmen, Le Cid, Iskalci biserov, Traviata in muzikala Mož iz La Manche.Koncert opernih arij je popestril nastop priznane kitajske pianistke Yuje Wang z izvedbo prvega stavka Klavirskega koncerta št. 1, P. I. Čajkovskega. Koncert je vodil kanadski dirigent Yannick Nezet-Seguin.

programme.title: Lemonade / Limonada
programme.desc: The pensioner Tone does not hide that he controls every step, shift and noise of the residents in the block in which he lives. From the window next to the entrance, it controls all arrivals and departures, and when it does not lie on the window, it listens to the front door. It records all the events he notices on his recorder. Tone Vohlja, warns of irregularities and stirs up when someone violates the house order. In the block, everything goes in the right order, until a new resident Milena has immersed in the block, who breaks down a system of complete control while raising interest in it. Milena is an attractive, lively and chatting pensioner who dreams of a love romance and lives in the parallel world of television Spanish sequels. And Tonet's awkward contact attempts begin. / Upokojenec Tone ne skriva, da nadzoruje vsak korak, premik in šum stanovalcev v bloku, v katerem živi. Z okna zraven vhoda nadzoruje vse prihode in odhode, ko ne tiči na oknu, pa prisluškuje pri vhodnih vratih. Vse dogajanje, ki ga opazi, zabeleži na svoj diktafon. Tone vohlja, opozarja na nepravilnosti in se zmrduje, ko nekdo krši hišni red.V bloku vse poteka po ustaljenem redu, dokler se v blok ne priseli nova stanovalka Milena, ki Tonetu poruši sistem popolnega nadzora, hkrati pa v njem vzbudi zanimanje. Milena je privlačna, živahna in klepetava upokojenka, ki sanja o ljubezenski romanci in živi v vzporednem svetu televizijskih španskih nadaljevank. In začnejo se Tonetovi nerodni poskusi navezovanja stika.

programme.title: A girl without a name / Punca brez imena
programme.desc: The owner of the inn Stane on the outskirts of the city one late evening is served by a young girl who turns out to be beaten by her boyfriend and thrown her to the street. / Lastnik gostilne Stane na obrobju mesta nekega poznega večera postreže mladi punci, za katero se izkaže, da jo je pretepel njen fant in jo vrgel na ulico.Stanetu se punca zasmili, odloči se, da ji bo pomagal, a se stvari sčasoma zasukajo v nepredvideno smer.

programme.desc: Zuli, Kian, Lars and FOZ reactors visit the Academy, where they learn and explore under the watchful eye of a mentor, a dancing unicorn leader. They travel all over the world, learn about the sights and solve the problems caused by their eternal opponent to the Grandmaster Zafrk. / Reaktivčki Zuli, Kian, Lars in Foz obiskujejo Akademijo, kjer se učijo in raziskujejo pod budnim očesom mentorja, plešočega samoroga Vodiroga. Potujejo po vsem svetu, spoznavajo znamenitosti in rešujejo težave, ki jih povzroča njihov večni nasprotnik Velemojster Zafrk.

programme.title: Bees: The one about fleas / Čebelice: Tista o bolhah
programme.desc: Also, do you all itch and scratch you after a long and long time? Oops, how only the cat queen, who really got real fleas should feel! Pssst! This is our secret, otherwise its highness will immediately forgive us… The cat queen has already dismissed half employees in Dvor. Don't let us distract us from reading her fun story. Nina, the fight, what they start, please! Stories sweet, without salad, a pinch of imagination in your pocket, give it a bee with the bee! Bober Bor and friends invite you to fly into the world of stories. Every night, before bed. It can also be for breakfast, lunch or dinner. Good stories come at every occasion, and so are these, from the Beehite Book Collection. We offer seven for tasting. It will be scheduled every Saturday - at 6:40 pm on the first TV Slovenia program. / Tudi vas kdaj vse srbi in se praskate po dolgem in počez? Ojoj, kako se mora počutiti šele mačja kraljica, ki je prav zares staknila čisto prave bolhe! Pssst! To je naša skrivnost, sicer nas bo njeno visočanstvo takoj odpustilo … Mačja kraljica je namreč odslovila že pol zaposlenih na dvoru. Naj nas to ne odvrne od branja njene zabavne zgodbe. Nina, Borček, kar začnita, prosim!Zgodbe sladke, brez solatke, ščepec domišljije v žepek daj, s Čebelico se poigraj! Bober Bor in prijatelji te vabijo, da z njimi poletiš v svet zgodb. Vsak večer, pred spanjem. Lahko pa tudi za zajtrk, kosilo ali večerjo. Dobre zgodbe se priležejo ob vsaki priložnosti in prav take so tudi te, iz zbirke Knjižnica Čebelica. Za pokušino jih ponudimo sedem. Na sporedu bodo vsako soboto - ob 18.40 na prvem programu TV Slovenija.

programme.title: Fisherman Pepe: About otherness / Ribič Pepe: O drugačnosti
programme.desc: Challenge in the snow, why not! Hat, gloves, scarves, sleds and Stari vrh, Pepe comes! At the invitation of Bishop's friends, he will descend through the snow slopes. It is not so difficult sledding. You sit and drive, nothing easier. That's what it seems at least. Holds the fists for Pepet too! The children's sequel speaks of the old wolf Pepet, who, in the old years, settled with his picturesque fishing barge on a port pier, where he is visited every day by children. Because he is a very skillful cartoonist, he all the time draws interesting pictures ... / Izziv na snegu, zakaj pa ne! Kapa, rokavice, šal, sanke in Stari vrh, Pepe prihaja! Na povabilo škofjeloških prijateljev se bo spustil po snežnih strminah. Saj sankanje ni tako zelo težko. Sedeš in se pelješ, nič lažjega. Tako se vsaj zdi. Drži pesti za Pepeta tudi ti!Otroška nadaljevanka govori o starem morskem volku Pepetu, ki se je na stara leta s svojo slikovito ribiško barkačo ustalil na pristaniškem pomolu, kjer ga vsak dan obiskujejo otroci. Ker je zelo spreten risar, ves čas riše zanimive slike...

programme.title: With as zofka: J as a linguist / Z kot Zofka: J kot jezikoslovec
programme.desc: Nejko and Ada got a special Zofka task. They need to put together a message. What and for whom? But they haven't found any words at all. Where are they hiding? programme.desc: Today we will present the story of a versatile politician, entrepreneur and artist Josip Pangerc, who will take us to the picturesque valley near Trieste, in places framed by the sea and the Karst. In the valley, Josip Pangerc, in the role of mayor between 1901 and 1914, introduced the office exclusively in the Slovene language. The valley municipality was receiving a new image; Roads, new schools, water supply and electrical wiring were being built. After his death in 1925, he remained a forgotten Slovenian for decades, but his legacy was revived at the National Museum of Slovenia at the initiative of the Central European Institute of History and Culture at the initiative of the Central European Institute of History and Culture. Consequently, the crossing of the state border is becoming an established and more common habit, which undoubtedly encourages learning about and therefore understanding the neighbor and thinking about and acting in the common space. Therefore, we also rely on the transitions from past thought framework to new ones. In it, with interesting guests from both sides of the former border, we present successful cooperation in various fields: culture, economy, science and social political life. / Danes bomo predstavili zgodba o vsestranskem politiku, podjetniku in umetniku Josipu Pangercu, ki nas bo popeljal v slikovito Dolino pri Trstu, v kraje, ki jih uokvirjata morje in kras. programme.title: Volleyball (Ž): Israel - Slovenia, Qualifications for EP 2025, Group C / Odbojka (Ž): Izrael - Slovenija, Kvalifikacije za EP 2025, Skupina C
programme.desc: The European Volleyball Championship for Women is an official competition of European countries organized under the auspices of the European Volleyball Federation (CEV). The tournament is a qualifying for countries that did not secure the final tournament in the previous competition and are not hosts who have the right to go to direct ranking. / Evropsko odbojkarsko prvenstvo za ženske je uradno tekmovanje evropskih držav, ki se organizira pod okriljem Evropske odbojkarske zveze (CEV).Uvod v turnir so kvalifikacije za države, ki si na prejšnjem tekmovanju niso zagotovile uvrstitev na končni turnir in niso domačinke, ki imajo pravico do neposredne uvrstitve.Format kvalifikacij se je skozi čas spreminjal, glede na število ekip.

programme.title: Draw a lot / Žrebanje Lota
programme.desc: The presenter takes us through the lot and Lot Plus, and in addition to the results of both draws, we also see the current winnings of the Joker game. / Voditeljica nas popelje skozi žrebanje Lota in Lota plus, poleg rezultatov obeh žrebanj pa si ogledamo tudi aktualne dobitke igre Joker.

programme.title: Environments / Ambienti
programme.desc: In a new settlement of family houses in Škofja Loka, one can easily imagine roots. The proximity of nature and at the same time infrastructure also attracted a young family from the rent, which erected a cozy house on 500 m2 of land, where natural materials played an important role. Hugs of wood and insulation protection made of stone and glass wool are its main ingredients. Old apartments often hide interesting stories. Sometimes we also find out, as in the following case. It may not be true, maybe every narrator added some detail to her, but ... when the word about love or passion, we always listen with interest. Sometimes the shape of the land is a special challenge for the placement of the house and also the garden. If the landscaping is undertaken by the home, the regulation will be slow, in accordance with the means available and the limited knowledge of the landscaping. Therefore, it is advisable to call for helping a garden expert as it will help them find the best possible solution. They also made the owners of the new house on the outskirts of Domžal, and with a joint effort they got a content -rich, functionally imagined and aesthetically consistent garden. Boštjan Romih, with the team, visits houses, gardens and apartments, and with the help of Slovenian architects discovers imaginative architectural solutions. The show is of interest to anyone interested in the architecture and equipment of ambients who want to build, equip or renovate a home. / V novem naselju družinskih hiš v Škofji Loki si človek zlahka predstavlja pognati korenine. Bližina narave in hkrati infrastrukture je iz najema privabila tudi mlado družino, ki je na 500 m2 velikem zemljišču postavila prijetno hišo, pri kateri so pomembno vlogo odigrali naravni materiali. Objem lesa ter izolacijska zaščita iz kamene in steklene volne so njene glavne sestavine. Stara stanovanja pogosto skrivajo zanimive zgodbe. Včasih katero tudi izvemo, tako kot v naslednjem primeru. Morda ni čisto resnična, morda ji je vsak pripovedovalec dodal kakšno podrobnost, pa vendar… Kadar je beseda o ljubezni ali strasti, vedno z zanimanjem prisluhnemo. Včasih oblika zemljišča predstavlja poseben izziv za umestitev hiše in tudi vrta. Če se ureditve okolice lotijo domači, bo urejanje potekalo počasi, skladno z razpoložljivimi sredstvi in omejenim znanjem o urejanju prostora. Zato je priporočljivo na pomoč poklicati strokovnjaka za urejanje vrtov, saj jim bo pomagal poiskati najboljšo možno rešitev. Tako sta storila tudi lastnika nove hiše na obrobju Domžal in s skupnim trudom so dobili vsebinsko bogat, funkcionalno domišljen in estetsko skladen vrt.Voditelj Boštjan Romih z ekipo obiskuje hiše, vrtove in stanovanja ter s pomočjo slovenskih arhitektov odkriva domiselne arhitekturne rešitve. Oddaja je zanimiva za vse, ki jih zanima arhitektura in oprema ambientov, ki želijo graditi, opremiti ali prenoviti dom.

programme.desc: In this documentary series, leader Thom Hunt, together with the recording team, visits people who have real supermochs who far beyond the known boundaries of the human spirit and body. For example, they have abilities that exist only in the animal world, capable of tearing fluid from tear channels or claiming that they have resistant hands. / V tej dokumentarni seriji voditelj Thom Hunt skupaj s snemalno ekipo obiskuje ljudi, ki imajo prave supermoči, ki daleč presegajo znane meje človeškega duha in telesa. Imajo na primer sposobnosti, ki sicer obstajajo le v živalskem svetu, so sposobni iz solznih kanalov brizgati tekočino ali trdijo, da imajo na vročino odporne roke.

programme.title: Road police officers / Cestni policisti
programme.desc: There are nearly 11,000 kilometers of highways in New Zealand. The care of these are safe and that traffic is smooth is the task of "highway police officers" whose daily work is shown here. They are not just dealing with too fast drivers and accidents. Inadequate vehicles or insufficiently secured cargo must also be removed from traffic before the accident occurs. / Na Novi Zelandiji je skoraj 11.000 kilometrov avtocest. Skrb za to, da so te varne in da promet poteka nemoteno, je naloga "avtocestnih policistov", katerih vsakodnevno delo je tukaj prikazano. Ne ukvarjajo se le s prehitrimi vozniki in nesrečami. Iz prometa morajo odstraniti tudi neustrezna vozila ali nezadostno zavarovan tovor, preden pride do nesreče.

programme.title: Football (M): Koper - Viking, Qualifications for Conference League 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Koper - Viking, Kvalifikacije za Konferenčno ligo 2025/2026
programme.desc: Since 2021, football fans will enjoy the conference league of Europe organized by UEFA. The idea for this league appeared in 2015 and includes a lower ranked team of national championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams will enter the competition, which will be divided into eight groups of four each. 16 teams will advance to the eighth finals, then to the quarterfinals, the semifinals and the finals. The winner of the final game will qualify for the European League next season. / Od leta 2021 bodo nogometni navdušenci uživali v Konferenčni ligi Evrope, ki jo organizira UEFA. Ideja za to ligo se je pojavila leta 2015, vključuje pa nižje rangirane ekipe državnih prvenstev. Kvalifikacije so razdeljene na dva dela, po katerih bo v tekmovanje vstopilo 32 ekip, ki bodo razdeljene v osem skupin po štiri. 16 ekip bo napredovalo v osmino finala, nato v četrtfinale, polfinale in finale. Zmagovalec finalne tekme se bo uvrstil v Ligo Evrope v naslednji sezoni.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Celje, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Celje, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.desc: Since 2021, football fans will enjoy the conference league of Europe organized by UEFA. programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Celje, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Celje, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: The last postillon from St. Gotthard / Der letzte Postillon vom St. Gotthard
programme.desc: Fluelen 1879. The steamship Winkelried overcons the Lake Lucerne and brings passengers for the Gotthardpost. The coachman Johannes Zgraggen can refrain from the day on which he will drive the last stalks over the passport, because the western Swiss engineer Louis Favre is driving an ambitious project on the Gotthard: Between Goshenen and Airolo, the longest railway tunnel in the world is being built between 1872 and 1882, but for the time being, the travelers still have to be brought to Italy. The conductor Kaspar Danioth tries to place the ladies and gentlemen in a possibly conflict -free manner in the four -span of carriage. Because he has reserved telegraphically, the American Steffen gets the gently outdoor area. The newly ground -in Berlin couple must therefore be used with the cabin, while young Angela and her travel well -being, the tunnel engineer Caminata, make themselves comfortable in the middle section. The mail goes off, and soon the lively travel company does not only come to the post. A poacher pursues his illegal craft high up in the mountains. And deep down in the mountain Italian guest workers on the tunnel, who will sustainably cause life on the Gotthard. Two historical data is even thored in the film: On July 18, 1879, the senior engineer Louis Favre died of a heart attack in the middle of the tunnel, and on February 29, 1880, the long-awaited piercing on the Gotthard died. For the covers, however, who had previously requested the passengers in their multi -clamped, post -yellow cars, it was the beginning of the end. The poet Friedrich Schneeberger has immortalized this fact in his melancholic folk song "I am the last postillon from the Gotthard ...". Even today, the melody of the evergreens in manner choirs and radios hunts concerts. And of course the stanzas accompanied by the posthorn are also sung in the film "The last postillon of the St. Gotthard" by the Kutscher Zgraggen when - high up on the go - over the last time he overturned the pass. / Fluelen 1879. Das Dampfschiff Winkelried uberquert den Vierwaldstattersee und bringt Passagiere fur die Gotthardpost. Der Kutscher Johannes Zgraggen kann den Tag absehen, an dem er die letzte Postkutsche uber den Pass fahren wird, denn der Westschweizer Ingenieur Louis Favre treibt am Gotthard ein ehrgeiziges Projekt voran: Zwischen Goschenen und Airolo entsteht zwischen 1872 und 1882 der langste Eisenbahntunnel der Welt.Doch vorerst mussen die Reisenden noch uber den Pass nach Italien gebracht werden. Der Kondukteur Kaspar Danioth versucht, die Damen und Herren moglichst konfliktfrei in der vierspannigen Kutsche zu platzieren. Weil er telegrafisch reserviert hat, bekommt der US-Amerikaner Steffen den schonsten Aussenplatz. Das frisch vermahlte Berliner Paar muss sich deshalb mit der Kabine begnugen, wahrend es sich die junge Angela und ihre Reisebekanntschaft, der Tunnelingenieur Caminata , im Mittelteil bequem machen.Ebenfalls gebucht haben der Bierbrauer Hafeli samt Gemahlin und der zu Reichtum gekommene Muller Torriani . Die Post geht ab, und schon bald hort die muntere Reisegesellschaft nicht nur das Posthorn, sondern auch einen Schuss. Hoch oben im Gebirge geht ein Wilderer seinem ungesetzlichen Handwerk nach. Und tief unten im Berg graben italienische Gastarbeiter am Tunnel, der das Leben am Gotthard nachhaltig verandern wird.In einigen Szenen zeigt Regisseur Heuberger, unter welch schwierigen Bedingungen der Bau des Gotthardtunnels vorangetrieben wurde. Zwei historische Daten werden im Film sogar ausfuhrlich gewurdigt: Am 18. Juli 1879 stirbt mitten im Tunnel der leitende Ingenieur Louis Favre an einem Herzinfarkt, und am 29. Februar 1880 erfolgt der lang ersehnte Durchstich am Gotthard.Die Eroffnung der Gotthard-Eisenbahnlinie am 1. Juni 1882 war ein Freudentag fur Europa. Fur die Kutscher aber, die bisher die Passagiere in ihren mehrspannigen, postgelben Wagen sicher uber den Pass befordert hatten, war es der Anfang vom Ende. Der Dichter Friedrich Schneeberger hat diesen Umstand in seinem melancholischen Volkslied «Ich bin vom Gotthard der letzte Postillon...» verewigt. Noch heute gehort die Melodie zu den Evergreens bei Mannerchoren und Radiowunschkonzerten. Und naturlich werden die vom Posthorn begleiteten Strophen auch im Film «Der letzte Postillon vom St. Gotthard» vom Kutscher Zgraggen gesungen, wenn er - hoch oben auf dem Bock - zum letzten Mal den Pass uberquert.

programme.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina / Bosnien und Herzegowina
programme.desc: Geographically, the country consists of the Bosnia region in the north, which takes around 80 percent of the state area, and the smaller region of Herzegovina in the Suden. Illyrians, Romer, Ottomans and Austrians have left their mark on this region. And so mosques, synagogues, Catholic and Orthodox churches stand side by side, and the north of the country is the north and biodiversity. Here is the Sutjeska National Park with the Peruc´ica jungle. In gentle waves, its beeches, spruce and pine, up to 60 meters high cover the rocky surface. For many endangered animal species, such as the Balkans, it is an important background area. The mushroom researcher Nedim Jukic examines the mushroom world in the Sutjeska National Park. He is looking for rare and dangerous types of mushrooms on the edge of the Glacier Lakes. They are important because they break down dead plant residues and save these lakes from growing up and disappear. The capital of Bjelas? Nica Lukomir, the oldest and 1455 meters, is also the country's highest village. Around 40 people and 4000 sheep live here from May to October. Omar Comor is the descendant of the last Bogumilen, which found refuge here. Bogumilen, “Friends of God”, were a early Christian community that lived in the Middle Ages in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Their tombs are scattered over the whole country, 24 of which are in Lukomir. In the outside northwest of the country, there is another unknown natural prison: the UNA National Park, named after the river of the same name. On a long of about 200 kilometers, the river runs through the park in narrow gorges, numerous rapids and impressive waterfalls. / Geografisch besteht das Land aus der Region Bosnien im Norden, die rund 80 Prozent des Staatsgebiets einnimmt, und der kleineren Region Herzegowina im Suden. Illyrer, Romer, Osmanen und Österreicher haben in dieser Region ihre Spuren hinterlassen. Und so stehen Moscheen, Synagogen, katholische und orthodoxe Kirchen selbstverstandlich nebeneinander.Wild und artenreich ist der Norden des Landes. Hier befindet sich der Nationalpark Sutjeska mit dem Peruc´ica Urwald. In sanften Wellen bedecken seine bis zu 60 Meter hohen Buchen, Fichten und Kiefern den felsigen Untergrund. Fur viele bedrohte Tierarten, wie den Balkanluchs, ist er ein bedeutendes Ruckzugsgebiet. Der Pilzforscher Nedim Jukic untersucht die Pilzwelt im Nationalpark Sutjeska. Er sucht nach seltenen und gefahrdeten Pilzarten am Rande der Gletscherseen. Sie sind wichtig, weil sie abgestorbene Pflanzenreste zersetzen und diese Seen vor dem Zuwachsen und dem Verschwinden retten.Unweit der Hauptstadt Sarajevo liegt auf dem Berg Bjelas?nica Lukomir, das alteste und auf 1455 Meter auch das ho¨chstgelegene Dorf des Landes. Von Mai bis Oktober leben hier etwa 40 Menschen und uber 4000 Schafe. Omar Comor ist der Nachfahre des letzten Bogumilen, der hier Zuflucht fand. Bogumilen, «Gottesfreunde», waren eine urchristliche Gemeinschaft, die im Mittelalter in Bosnien und Herzegowina gelebt hat. Ihre Grabmale sind uber das ganze Land verstreut, 24 davon liegen in Lukomir.Im aussersten Nordwesten des Landes liegt eine weitere unbekannte Naturschonheit: Der Nationalpark Una, benannt nach dem gleichnamigen Fluss. Auf einer Lange von etwa 200 Kilometern durchzieht der Fluss den Park in engen Schluchten, zahlreichen Stromschnellen und beeindruckenden Wasserfallen.Erstausstrahlung: 04.08.2025

programme.title: Atlantics / Atlantics
programme.desc: The workers protest on a construction site in Dakar. They request the reward that you have not received in three months. Among them is also Souleiman (Ibrahima Traore), who meets his beloved Ada on the beach shortly afterwards. He decided to go away with some colleagues, Ubers Meer into promising Europe. Ada, who has to meet him secretly because she is actually promised to the rich Omar, has no idea that this will be her last encounter. Shortly, everyone in the city has sunk that the boat that the young men had to go to a better future has dropped. The women, children and ADA that remained removed do not know what happened to their loved ones. A few days after the unreal, a fire cuddles the house and Omar intended for the wedding of Ada and Omar and young women in the neighborhood attacks a mysterious fever. Ada has no idea whether Souleiman still lives or is already a spirit among them. According to his own statements, Mati Diop wanted to make a film about a very specific period of time, between 2002 and 2010, in which many young Senegalese had broken up towards Europe. The women are strong figures in their film that oppose and demand justice for their friends and husbands. “Atlantique” is just as much a socially critical love and migration drama as an excessive zombie film. Diop uses the genre conventions in a very steady way, not just as quotes from western models. Her fantastic pictures of the Labyrinthian Dakar and the scary and hypnotically staged sea are supported by the magnetic soundtrack of Fatima al Qadiri. The diop grew up in France has a Senegalese father who is a well-known musician, her French mother is photographer and art director. She worked as an actress and made short films and a documentary before she presented her first long feature film with “Atlantique”. After the premiere in Cannes, where she was the first black director in the competition, he was awarded the greater price of the jury. The film was then sent to the Oscar race in 2020 by Senegal as a "Best International Film". "Delicatics" shows "Atlantique" as a free TV premiere in the original version with German subtitles. / Auf einer Baustelle in Dakar protestieren die Arbeiter. Sie fordern den Lohn ein, den sie seit drei Monaten nicht bekommen haben. Unter ihnen ist auch Souleiman (Ibrahima Traore), der sich kurz danach mit seiner geliebten Ada am Strand trifft. Er hat mit einigen Kollegen beschlossen wegzufahren, ubers Meer ins verheissungsvolle Europa. Ada, die ihn heimlich treffen muss, weil sie eigentlich dem reichen Omar versprochen ist, ahnt nicht, dass das ihre letzte Begegnung sein wird.Kurz darauf erfahren alle in der Stadt, dass das Boot, das die jungen Manner in eine bessere Zukunft hatte fuhren sollen, gesunken ist. Die zuruckgebliebenen Frauen, Kinder und auch Ada wissen nicht, was mit ihren Liebsten passiert ist. Wenige Tage nach dem Ungluck verwustet ein Feuer das fur die Hochzeit von Ada und Omar vorgesehene Haus und junge Frauen in der Nachbarschaft befallt ein mysterioses Fieber. Ada hat keine Ahnung, ob Souleiman noch lebt oder als Geist bereits unter ihnen weilt.Mati Diop wollte nach eigenen Aussagen einen Film uber eine ganz bestimmte Zeitspanne machen, zwischen 2002 und 2010, in der viele junge Senegalesen Richtung Europa aufgebrochen waren. Die Frauen sind in ihrem Film starke Figuren, die sich widersetzen und Gerechtigkeit fu¨r ihre Freunde und Ehemanner fordern. «Atlantique» ist ebenso sozialkritisches Liebes- und Migrationsdrama wie ubersinnlicher Zombiefilm. Dabei gebraucht Diop die Genrekonventionen in einer ganz eigenstandigen Art und Weise, nicht bloss als Zitate von westlichen Vorbildern. Unterstutzt werden ihre fantastischen Bilder des labyrinthischen Dakars und des unheimlich und hypnotisch in Szene gesetzten Meeres durch den magnetischen Soundtrack von Fatima Al Qadiri.Die in Frankreich aufgewachsene Diop hat einen senegalesischen Vater, der ein bekannter Musiker ist, ihre franzosische Mutter ist Fotografin und Art-Direktorin. Sie selbst arbeitete als Schauspielerin und machte Kurzfilme und einen Dokumentarfilm, bevor sie mit «Atlantique» ihren ersten Langspielfilm vorlegte. Dieser wurde nach der Premiere in Cannes, wo sie als erste schwarze Regisseurin am Wettbewerb teilnahm, mit dem Grossen Preis der Jury ausgezeichnet. Der Film wurde danach von Senegal als «Bester auslandischer Film» ins Oscar-Rennen 2020 geschickt.«Delikatessen» zeigt «Atlantique» als Free-TV-Premiere in der Originalversion mit deutschen Untertiteln.

programme.title: The best democracy in the world? - The Swiss model as an idea for Germany? / Die beste Demokratie der Welt? - Das Schweizer Modell als Idee fur Deutschland?
programme.sub-title: Die Schweiz - Die beste Demokratie der Welt?
programme.desc: Switzerland is considered to be a haven of true democracy, because the Swiss vocal people can contribute directly to initiatives and referenders, and strong foderalism ensures a flat distribution of the circumstances. Because to the urn, less than the half of all people who live in Switzerland goes. On the one hand, because only resident with Swiss passport and over 18 years of age are entitled to vote and voting, on the other hand because of the growing number of those who stay away from the urn, so Switzerland really is the Democracy pattern country? Is it fair against the background that the gap between poor and the empire is going on? Has democracy possibly rush its zenith? Or is she still the worst of all forms of government, apart from everyone else, as Winston Churchill once put it? Einerseits, weil nur Einwohnende mit Schweizer Pass und uber 18-Jahrige stimm- und wahlberechtigt sind, andererseits wegen der wachsenden Zahl derjenigen, die der Urne fernbleiben.Ist die Schweiz also wirklich das Demokratie-Musterland? Und ist die direkte Demokratie noch zeitgemass angesichts der Tatsache, dass sie beispielsweise ungeeignet scheint, griffige Massnahmen gegen den Klimawandel voranzutreiben? Ist sie gerecht vor dem Hintergrund, dass die Schere zwischen Arm und Reich immer weiter aufgeht? Hat die Demokratie ihren Zenit womoglich uberschritten? Stemmle, der 1974 in Baden-Baden starb, zahlte zu den bewahrtesten Saulen des deutschen Nachkriegsfilms. Seit den 30er-Jahren drehte er Filme. Fur viele davon schrieb er - wie zum Beispiel fur «Ein Herz voll Musik» - auch das Drehbuch. St. Moritz, Arosa, Cortina dAmpezzo und Rom sind die attraktiven Schauplatze dieser gefuhlsvollen Musikproduktion. Simona und Yuri lernen mutige Menschen kennen, die sich von den widrigen Umstanden nicht unterkriegen lassen: eine junge Mutter etwa, die sich entgegen dem Trend der tiefen Geburtenrate in Italien fur ein Kind entschieden hat und deswegen grosse Kompromisse eingehen muss. programme.title: In use at the Great Barrier Reef / Im Einsatz am Great Barrier Reef
programme.desc: Along the Australian chest extends over 2300 kilometers in the waters of the Pacific one of the most important natural world miracles. The Great Barrier Reef is the greatest animal building of the planet. The heating of the oceans and climate change today put its resistance to one tough test. / Entlang der australischen Kuste erstreckt sich uber 2300 Kilometer in den Gewassern des Pazifiks eines der bedeutendsten Naturweltwunder. Das Great Barrier Reef ist das grosste tierische Bauwerk des Planeten. Die Erwarmung der Ozeane und der Klimawandel stellen seine Widerstandskraft heute auf eine harte Probe.

programme.title: Fascination water / Faszination Wasser
programme.desc: The islands of the Chagos archipelago are British overseas areas. The water around the archipelago are under strict protection. This is also why the underwater world is so diverse and colorful. Together with a team of researchers, the marine biologist Uli Kunz goes on a discovery tour: How do the protective area in the Chagos Archipelago Haie, Mantarochen and Sebvogel? What types occur? And how does climate change affect this remote region? For the researchers, the different islands are a huge open -air laboratory. There they found out that the Guano - the bird droppings - flows from the islands into the sea also uses the coral reefs: the reefs in front of the bird islands are more healthy and more fishy. Research in the Chagos archipelago is also of great importance for other regions of the world. Because today corals are under heat stress almost everywhere due to the increasing warming of the oceans. More than the half of the reefs is very dangerous. / Die Inseln des Chagos-Archipels sind britisches Überseegebiet. Die Gewasser rund um den Archipel stehen unter strengem Schutz. Auch deshalb ist die Unterwasserwelt so vielfaltig und bunt. Gemeinsam mit einem Team von Forschenden geht der Meeresbiologe Uli Kunz auf Entdeckungstour: Wie nutzen im Chagos-Archipel Haie, Mantarochen und Seevogel das Schutzgebiet? Welche Arten kommen vor? Und wie beeinflusst der Klimawandel diese abgelegene Region?Fur die Forschenden sind die unterschiedlichen Inseln ein riesiges Freiluftlabor. Dort haben sie herausgefunden, dass der Guano - der Vogelkot -, der von den Inseln aus ins Meer fliesst, auch den Korallenriffen nutzt: Die Riffe vor den Vogelinseln sind gesunder und fischreicher. Die Forschung im Chagos-Archipel hat auch fur andere Regionen der Welt grosse Bedeutung. Denn fast uberall stehen Korallen heute aufgrund der zunehmenden Erwarmung der Ozeane unter Hitzestress. Mehr als die Halfte der Riffe ist stark gefahrdet.

programme.title: Fascination water / Faszination Wasser
programme.desc: Ice sharks, narwhales, mysterious ice algae and unique underwater saces. The moderator and marine biologist Uli Kunz explores the unknown sides of Gronland. Uli Kunz travels to the east of Gronland to study a very special resident of the Arctic: the Eishai, also called Gronlandhai. No other vertebrate can grow old - age than 500 years. In its icy living space, the shark lives in slow motion. During the inuit the huge fish has known for a long time, science hardly knows anything about him. The world under the ice has an hostile effect, but there are also life there, such as ribs, rowing snails and Kelpwalder with its numerous inhabitants. As soon as the ice breaks, Narwhales pull up the narrow water streets. The world on the Arctic Circle is different. Signs for this can be found everywhere. Gronland is a kind of fever thermometer for climate change - and for the question of how nature can adapt to the changes. / Eishaie, Narwale, geheimnisvolle Eisalgen und einzigartige Unterwasser-Saulen. Der Moderator und Meeresbiologe Uli Kunz erkundet die unbekannten Seiten Gronlands. Uli Kunz reist in den Osten von Gronland, um einen ganz besonderen Bewohner der Arktis zu studieren: den Eishai, auch Gronlandhai genannt. Kein anderes Wirbeltier kann so alt werden - alter als 500 Jahre. In seinem eisigen Lebensraum fuhrt der Hai ein Leben in Zeitlupe. Wahrend die Inuit den gewaltigen Fisch seit Langem kennen, weiss die Wissenschaft kaum etwas uber ihn.Die Welt unter dem Eis wirkt lebensfeindlich, doch auch dort gibt es Leben, etwa Rippenquallen, Ruderschnecken und Kelpwalder mit ihren zahlreichen Bewohnern. Sobald das Eis aufbricht, ziehen Narwale die schmalen Wasserstrassen hinauf. Die Welt am Polarkreis verandert sich. Anzeichen dafur sind uberall zu finden. Gronland ist eine Art Fieberthermometer fur den Klimawandel - und fur die Frage, wie sich die Natur an die Veranderungen anpassen kann.

programme.title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou - Die Tiefseetaucher / The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou - Die Tiefseetaucher
programme.desc: The big deep sea diver Steve Zissou has seen better days. His long -term partner was eaten by a Jaguarhai, and when Zissou celebrates the premiere of his latest film, the audience reacts with an unexpected manner. In this severe crisis, a young man appears who claims to be Zissou's illegitimate son: Ned Plimton. Zissou does not take it under his wing, rust it with a red woolen cap and charter a ship for a last mission with his crew: like a modern Kapkten Ahab on the beast who has his partner on his conscience. Zissous still-wife Eleanor. Once on the high seas, the cranky ship crew revives old tubes; To this end, there are disputes with Zissou's personal adversary Alistair Hennessey and with an unfriendly gang of Philippine pirates. The magazine of the British film institute described this film as follows: «Wes Anderson's Ensemble comedy The Life Aquatic, as if Jacques Cousteau Fellinis had filmed 8½.» In fact, Wes Anderson designs a universe full of cute figures that often appear lost in the film of the film - with overmate cute effect. His film is an ornamental fishing aquarium full of shimmering ideas such as that of cutting the ship like a doll's house to map what is happening on board. In the figure of the Steve Zissou shining in the reference to the French deep sea film Jacques Cousteau, Bill Murray is also stars like Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Anjelica Huston, Willem Dafoe or Jeff Goldblum shows "The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou - The deep -sea vacuum" Exclusively in two sewer sound German/English. / Der grosse Tiefseetaucher Steve Zissou hat schon bessere Tage gesehen. Sein langjahriger Partner wurde von einem Jaguarhai gefressen, und als Zissou die Premiere seines neusten Filmes feiert, reagiert das Publikum mit unverhohlenem Unverstandnis. In dieser schweren Krise taucht ein junger Mann auf, der behauptet, Zissous unehelicher Sohn zu sein: Ned Plimpton . Zissou nimmt Ned unter seine Fittiche, rustet ihn mit einer roten Wollkappe aus und chartert mit seiner Crew ein Schiff fur eine letzte Mission: sich wie ein moderner Kapten Ahab an der Bestie zu rachen, der seinen Partner auf dem Gewissen hat.Zum illustren Gruppchen gesellen sich die schwangere Reporterin Jane Winslett-Richardson , die Zissou zum Subjekt ihrer neuen Reportage erkurt, sowie Zissous Noch-Ehefrau Eleanor . Einmal auf hoher See lasst die verschrobene Schiffscrew alte Zwiste aufleben; dazu drohen Auseinandersetzungen mit Zissous personlichem Widersacher Alistair Hennessey und mit einer unfreundlichen Bande philippinischer Piraten.Die Zeitschrift des Britischen Filminstitutes beschrieb diesen Film wie folgt: «Wes Andersons Ensemble-Komodie The Life Aquatic wirkt, als hatte Jacques Cousteau Fellinis 8½ verfilmt.» Tatsachlich entwirft Wes Anderson ein Universum voller kauziger Figuren, die im Plot des Filmes oft verloren wirken - mit uberaus putzigem Effekt. Sein Film ist ein Zierfischaquarium voller schillernder Einfalle wie etwa jenem, das Schiff wie ein Puppenhaus aufzuschneiden, um das Geschehen an Bord abzubilden. In der Figur des in Anspielung auf den franzosischen Tiefseefilmer Jacques Cousteau gestalteten Steve Zissou brilliert Bill Murray, daneben sind Stars wie Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Anjelica Huston, Willem Dafoe oder Jeff Goldblum zu sehen.«Delikatessen» zeigt «The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou - Die Tiefseetaucher» exklusiv in Zweikanalton deutsch/englisch.

programme.title: Tagesschau 20 years ago / Tagesschau vor 20 Jahren
programme.desc: The “Tagesschau” of Swiss television has been providing the news look since 1953. The aim is to bring the most important topics at home and abroad every evening. Which domestic debates and international conflicts prompted the reporting at the time - and which of them are still doing it today? The view of the archive offers the possibility of climbing, classifying and remembering. / Die «Tagesschau» des Schweizer Fernsehens liefert seit 1953 allabendlich den Nachrichtenuberblick. Im Laufe der Jahre wurde die Sendung immer wieder angepasst - an die technologischen Entwicklungen, vor allem aber an die Bedurfnisse des Publikums. Gleich geblieben ist der Anspruch, jeden Abend die wichtigsten Themen im In- und Ausland kurz und verstandlich aufzubereiten.Die «Tagesschau vor 20 Jahren» bietet einen Nachrichtenruckblick in die jungere Geschichte: Welche Themen bewegten heute vor exakt 20 Jahren? Welche innenpolitischen Debatten und internationalen Konflikte pragten damals die Berichterstattung - und welche davon tun es bis heute? programme.title: In use at the Great Barrier Reef / Im Einsatz am Great Barrier Reef
programme.desc: Along the Australian chest extends over 2300 kilometers in the waters of the Pacific one of the most important natural world miracles. programme.title: Fascination water / Faszination Wasser
programme.desc: The Chagos archipelago in the Indian Ocean is an island paradise and one of the greatest marine national parks. Why are the coral reefs there healthy and more diverse than in other regions? Together with a team of researchers, marine biologist and "Terra X" moderator Uli Kunz go on a discovery tour: How do sharks, mantarochets and seabird use the protected area? What types occur? And how does climate change affect this remote region? The almost 60 islands of the Chagos archipelago are British overseas areas. On the biggest island, Diego Garcia, the Americans run a militar base - all other islands are uninhabited. The water around the archipelago are under strict protection, nobody is allowed to fish there. This is also why the underwater world is so diverse and colorful. People have never settled on many islands - they still belong to the palm thief, the largest land -living cancer in the world, and huge colonies of birds. On other islands, however, rats have spread - and agreed on bird eggs and cows. For the researchers, the different islands are a huge open -air laboratory. There they found that the Guano - the bird droppings - which flows from the islands into the sea, also uses the coral reefs. The reefs in front of the bird islands are healthy and more fishy. Sea bird does not make a coral reef immune to climate change, but after a coral bleach, the reefs can recover faster. "These are completely new knowledge / Der Chagos-Archipel im Indischen Ozean ist ein Inselparadies und einer der groSSten Meeresnationalparks. Warum sind die Korallenriffe dort gesunder und artenreicher als in anderen Regionen? Gemeinsam mit einem Team von Forschenden geht Meeresbiologe und "Terra X"-Moderator Uli Kunz auf Entdeckungstour: Wie nutzen Haie, Mantarochen und Seevogel das Schutzgebiet? Welche Arten kommen vor? Und wie beeinflusst der Klimawandel diese abgelegene Region? Die fast 60 Inseln des Chagos-Archipels sind britisches Überseegebiet. Auf der groSSten Insel, Diego Garcia, betreiben die Amerikaner eine Militarbasis - alle anderen Inseln sind unbewohnt. Die Gewasser rund um den Archipel stehen unter strengem Schutz, niemand darf dort fischen. Auch deshalb ist die Unterwasserwelt so vielfaltig und bunt. Auf vielen Inseln haben noch nie Menschen gesiedelt - bis heute gehoren sie dem Palmendieb, dem groSSten landlebenden Krebs der Welt, und gewaltigen Vogelkolonien. Auf anderen Inseln jedoch haben sich Ratten ausgebreitet - und sich uber Vogeleier und Kuken hergemacht. Fur die Forschenden sind die unterschiedlichen Inseln ein riesiges Freiluftlabor. Dort haben sie herausgefunden, dass der Guano - der Vogelkot -, der von den Inseln aus ins Meer flieSSt, auch den Korallenriffen nutzt. Die Riffe vor den Vogelinseln sind gesunder und fischreicher. Zwar machen Seevogel ein Korallenriff nicht immun gegen den Klimawandel, aber nach einer Korallenbleiche konnen sich die Riffe schneller erholen. "Das sind ganz neue Erkenntnisse

programme.title: Fascination water / Faszination Wasser
programme.desc: Ice sharks, narwhales, mysterious ice algae and unique underwater saces. The moderator and marine biologist Uli Kunz explores the unknown sides of Gronland. Uli Kunz travels to the east of Gronland to study a very special resident of the Arctic: the Eishai, also called Gronlandhai. No other vertebrate can grow old - age than 500 years. In its icy living space, the shark lives in slow motion. During the inuit the huge fish has known for a long time, science hardly knows anything about him. The world under the ice has an hostile effect, but there are also life there, such as ribs, rowing snails and Kelpwalder with its numerous inhabitants. As soon as the ice breaks, Narwhales pull up the narrow water streets. The world on the Arctic Circle is different. Signs for this can be found everywhere. Gronland is a kind of fever thermometer for climate change - and for the question of how nature can adapt to the changes. / Eishaie, Narwale, geheimnisvolle Eisalgen und einzigartige Unterwasser-Saulen. Der Moderator und Meeresbiologe Uli Kunz erkundet die unbekannten Seiten Gronlands. Uli Kunz reist in den Osten von Gronland, um einen ganz besonderen Bewohner der Arktis zu studieren: den Eishai, auch Gronlandhai genannt. Kein anderes Wirbeltier kann so alt werden - alter als 500 Jahre. In seinem eisigen Lebensraum fuhrt der Hai ein Leben in Zeitlupe. Wahrend die Inuit den gewaltigen Fisch seit Langem kennen, weiss die Wissenschaft kaum etwas uber ihn.Die Welt unter dem Eis wirkt lebensfeindlich, doch auch dort gibt es Leben, etwa Rippenquallen, Ruderschnecken und Kelpwalder mit ihren zahlreichen Bewohnern. Sobald das Eis aufbricht, ziehen Narwale die schmalen Wasserstrassen hinauf. Die Welt am Polarkreis verandert sich. Anzeichen dafur sind uberall zu finden. Gronland ist eine Art Fieberthermometer fur den Klimawandel - und fur die Frage, wie sich die Natur an die Veranderungen anpassen kann.

programme.title: Real Madrid: how am I going to love you / Real Madrid: como no te voy a querer
programme.sub-title: Si me haces sentir como en casa
programme.desc: In Real Madrid the ambition and the requirement to conquer all titles puts managers, technical body and players every year. In the 2023-24 season the team has been reinforced to form a template at the height of the challenge: complete a decade that can make the team a legend and write a new golden page of the club into the history of football. Santiago Bernabeu is not just a stadium. It is a magical place where dreams come true and the impossible happens. The true magic appears in the return of the Champions Semifinals against Bayern in Munich, in which the stadium is conjured to compose another unforgettable deed. It is also Joselu's night that had always sounded to succeed at Real Madrid. / En el Real Madrid la ambicion y la exigencia de conquistar todos los títulos pone a prueba a directivos, cuerpo tecnico y jugadores cada año. En la temporada 2023-24 el equipo se ha reforzado para formar una plantilla a la altura del desafío: completar una decada que puede convertir al equipo en leyenda y escribir una nueva página dorada del club en la historia del fútbol. El Santiago Bernabeu no es solo un estadio. Es un lugar magico donde los suenos se hacen realidad y sucede lo imposible. La verdadera magia aparece en la vuelta de las semifinales de Champions ante el Bayern de Munich, en la que el estadio se conjura para componer otra gesta inolvidable. Es tambien la noche de Joselu que siempre habia sonado con triunfar en el Real Madrid.
